design_rationale:
WORKLOG / DOSSIER — task 0 (difficulty weekly_certification_and_benefit_payment, category claim). Revision 2 (policy-task audit round 1 closed; see [Revision log]).
[Step 0 draw] draw_counts.py --task 0 -> prerequisite_problems=3, factor_counts=[4,4,4,4]; every problem takes 4 factors.
[Scope] First task. Claims claim_ext_dependency_redetermination, claim_ext_payment_election_lead, claim_ext_parent_shortfall_supplement, claim_ext_extension_entitlement and their tools record_dependency_redetermination_c7b3c182, elect_payment_method_0e517696 (owner user), issue_supplemental_payment_38b81267, determine_extension_entitlement_db601fac. Task 1 holds the remaining four policies (dependency disallowance, waiting-week value, holiday-pay certification, weekly payment), an independent new-claim tree.
[Why a good test] The caller asks one thing: get her extended benefits set up. The Extended Benefits rule waits on two record states: the parent's last paid week carries no supplemental payment for its shortfall, and the parent's dependency allowance does not count the dependent added to the record. The supplemental correction itself waits on the redetermined allowance and on a payment election the claimant must record herself after the identity theft re-verification of 2026-09-10. The difficulty is reading those prerequisite sentences, reconciling 32 certifications and 36 ledger rows, an overpayment and an identity case in other products, and four 4-factor computations.
[Problem tree card] Root claim_ext_extension_entitlement. (1) supplemental <- redetermination, value_input, gate da, state: 'A supplemental correction is computed only once the claim's dependency allowance counts every dependent added to the record.'; false: dependency_allowance 15.0 with dependents_count 2. (2) supplemental <- election (USER), state_gate, gate claims.payment_method_effective_date, state: 'A supplemental payment is not issued until the claim carries a payment method election recorded after the latest identity theft re-verification of the claimant was verified.'; false: the method on record (paper_check) took effect 2026-09-10, the verification date, not after. (3) entitlement <- supplemental, value_input, gate paid, state: 'The Extended Benefits maximum benefit amount is fixed only after the parent claim's last paid week carries a supplemental payment for its shortfall.'; false: week 2026-09-05 has only its 252.00 weekly payment, the only supplemental is for 2026-04-18; only the supplemental write leaves a supplemental payment on a ledger. (4) entitlement <- redetermination, value_input, gate da, state: 'The Extended Benefits maximum benefit amount is not fixed until the parent claim's dependency allowance counts every dependent added to the record.'. Each sentence joins the policy's own result to the state it waits on with an ordering connective, names no tool, id or code token, and states a hard requirement; directions are mixed. Order RD, EL, SUP, TD; RD and EL commute (they read and write disjoint fields). Deletion sensitivity: claim_ext_parent_shortfall_supplement -> claim_ext_dependency_redetermination: Without the redetermination the supplemental amount is 150.0 instead of 168.0 (allowance 15.00, cap 150.00) ; that payment still takes the whole 150.00 balance, so the parent stands exhausted either way and only the supplemental amount (and through it the Extended Benefits amount) differs.; claim_ext_parent_shortfall_supplement -> claim_ext_payment_election_lead: Without the election the claim keeps payment_method paper_check effective 2026-09-10 and no claimant election row exists; the supplemental written anyway would be issued against an unmet gate, so the terminal claims row differs (payment_method, payment_method_effective_date).; claim_ext_extension_entitlement -> claim_ext_parent_shortfall_supplement: Without the supplemental the Extended Benefits maximum benefit amount is 7002 instead of 7089 and the parent stays active with 168.00.; claim_ext_extension_entitlement -> claim_ext_dependency_redetermination: Without the redetermination the Extended Benefits maximum benefit amount is 6960 instead of 7089 (allowance 15.00, training week valued at 457.50)..
[Base-invariant card] Supplemental (claim_benefit_paid): claim_payable_status — parent active at handling time; one_payment_per_week_and_kind — week 2026-09-05 has a weekly payment (252.00) and no supplemental; one_claim_paid_per_week — a supplemental is not a second weekly payment; waiting week 2026-01-31 served. Election: no_change_under_fraud_review — hold_reason none. Redetermination and entitlement (claim_entitlement_credited): claim_monetary_eligibility, policy_scope; the EB minimum-weeks-of-full-time-employment eligibility is shown through its wage equivalent, which the extended rule states and declares in overwrite: parent base-period wages 36093.61 >= 40 x 450.00 = 18000.00 on the parent claim row, so the claim is eligible and is not determined at zero. No time gate.
[Business-object card] Parent claim 0d9a89f4-2c5d-4dcf-a80e-af92388f63ee (UCFE, effective 2026-01-25, MBA 12030.00, balance 150.00). Corrected week 2026-09-05: earnings 300.00, 17.0 hours, claimant-contributed pension 96.00, paid 252.00 by the standard method. Excluded from 'already paid': the 2026-08-29 original, cancellation and reissue, and the 2026-04-18 supplemental (other weeks). EB claim 19ac0893-e541-4425-8cc3-95568ddcd247 names the parent. Overpayment 424a3c51 (Non-Fraud — Claimant Error, 274.00, established 2026-09-09, inside its appeal window, not in recovery) stands against the parent; no fraud overpayment.
[Factor card] RD: per_dependent_amount_redetermination (parameter): evidence claim_age = 233, per_dep = 18.00; tier taken: 'two or more dependents on record and the claim effective date at least the long-claim days before the handling date'; its baseline (P('dependency_allowance_per_dependent')) gives result 15 instead of 18. | credited_weeks_redetermination (method): evidence paid_weeks = 31, weeks_basis = 1; tier taken: 'at least the late-claim number of weekly payments issued on the claim'; its baseline (P('max_duration_weeks')) gives result 487 instead of 18. | allowance_ceiling_redetermination (parameter): evidence det_age = 228, da_new = 33.75; tier taken: 'the latest monetary determination is more than the late-addition days old'; its baseline (RND(per_dep * counted, 2)) gives result 21 instead of 18. | wage_cap_fraction_redetermination (parameter): evidence credits = 12030.00, frac = 0.36; tier taken: 'standard base period used, base-period wages at least the steady-earner ratio times high-quarter wages, and the entitlement credited on the claim already at the wage-capped amount'; its baseline (P('mba_bpw_fraction')) gives result 0 instead of 18. | all baselines -> 0. EL: prenote_days (parameter): evidence returned = 1, dd_paid = 31, prenote = 5; tier taken: 'a deposit on the claim returned by the bank within the returned-deposit window'; its baseline (0) gives result 10 instead of 15. | verification_days (parameter, cross-difficulty idv): evidence theft_verified = 2026-09-10, other_verified = 2026-09-10, verif = 3; tier taken: 'the most recently verified Identity Theft Victim Re-Verification case on the claim verified within the recent-verification days'; its baseline (0) gives result 10 instead of 15. | payment_cycle_rounding (method): evidence last_method = paper_check, result_cycle = 15; tier taken: 'the latest payment on the claim issued by paper check'; its baseline (total) gives result 13 instead of 15. | change_review_days (parameter): evidence change_age = 5, review = 3; tier taken: 'the payment method on the claim took effect no more than the recent-change days before'; its baseline (0) gives result 10 instead of 15. | all baselines -> 2. SUP: disregard_share_supplemental (parameter): evidence hrs3 = 208.50, share = 0.50; tier taken: 'the claim records enrolled approved training and the attachment hours total at least the attachment threshold'; its baseline (P('earnings_disregard_pct_of_wba')) gives result 123.00 instead of 168.00. | full_time_threshold_supplemental (parameter): evidence recall_days = -1, thr = 36; tier taken: 'the separation recorded on the claim is reduced hours'; its baseline (P('full_time_hours_threshold')) gives result 150.00 instead of 168.00. | excess_earnings_rate_supplemental (parameter): evidence hours = 17.00, earn_ded = 37.50; tier taken: 'hours reported for the corrected week below the low-hours fraction of the full-time hours threshold'; its baseline (excess) gives result 131.00 instead of 168.00. | pension_deduction_supplemental (method): evidence opay_type = pension_claimant_contributed, opay = 96.00, pen_ded = 25.50; tier taken: 'a claimant-contributed pension no more than the small-pension fraction of the weekly benefit amount'; its baseline (RND(opay * (P('pension_offset_pct_claimant_contributed') if opay_type == 'pension_claimant_contributed' else P('pension_offset_pct')), 2) if opay_type == 'pension_employer_funded' or opay_type == 'pension_claimant_contributed' else 0) gives result 146.00 instead of 168.00. | all baselines -> 18.0. TD: eb_fraction (parameter, multi-source): evidence weekly_count = 31 on the parent ledger and parent base_period_wages = 36093.61 >= 60 x 450.00 = 27000.00, eb_frac = 0.52; tier taken: 'at least the long-claim number of weekly payments issued on the parent and parent base-period wages at least the high-wage test times its weekly benefit amount'; its baseline (K('eb_standard_fraction')) gives result 6854 instead of 7089. | parent_entitlement_measure (method, cross-difficulty overpay): evidence fraud_n = 0, est_principal = 274.00, measure = 11774.00; tier taken: 'one or more non-fraud overpayments against the parent claim at status established and no fraud overpayment against it'; its baseline (paid - cancelled) gives result 7231 instead of 7089. | training_weeks_added (parameter): evidence claim_age = 233, addon_weeks = 2; tier taken: 'enrolled approved training on the parent and the parent claim at least the training age in days old'; its baseline (0) gives result 6122 instead of 7089. | training_week_value (parameter): evidence det_age = 0, addon_weekly = 483.75; tier taken: 'the parent carries a dependency allowance and its latest monetary determination is no more than the redetermination window days old'; its baseline (wba) gives result 7022 instead of 7089. | all baselines -> 6024. Genuine method factors: credited_weeks_redetermination (balance-based weeks vs a share vs full duration), payment_cycle_rounding (round up to the paper-check cycle vs add card activation days vs as counted), pension_deduction_supplemental (disregard-then-share vs whole pension at a share), parent_entitlement_measure (net of established non-fraud principal vs zero vs paid). Multi-source: disregard_share_supplemental (training on the claim AND attachment hours on certifications) and eb_fraction (weekly payment count AND parent wages against the high-wage test). Cross-difficulty: parent_entitlement_measure (overpay, XCOUNT/XSUM), verification_days (idv). Near-misses: 2026-08-29 reissue (not the latest weekly payment), January IAL2 case (outside 30 days), 2026-04-18 supplemental (other week), 17.0 hours just under the 18-hour line.
[Overrides] Declared in overwrite: supplemental — earnings-deduction, full-time and other-pay sentences of claim_evt_payable_amount; redetermination — the dependency-allowance and maximum-benefit sentences of claim_monetary_eligibility; entitlement — the maximum-benefit clause and the minimum-weeks clause of the EB sentence (the latter replaced by its base-period-wage equivalent, evidenced on the parent claim); election — the fixed lead sentence. Everything else (status gates, dedup, one claim per week, offsets after the amount, non_charged code for UCFE) is inherited.
[World rows] customers 1; claims 2; claim_certifications 32; claim_ledger 36 (credit 12030.00, waiting week, 31 weekly payments by the standard method summing with the rest to 11880.00 net, the 2026-04-18 supplemental, the returned-deposit cancellation and reissue); idv_cases 2; overpayments 1; overpay_ledger 1. No withholding order, no overpayment in recovery, UCFE non-charged: no payment owes an offset, deduction or charge posting.
[Persona] Corinne volunteers only her goal; identity on request; dependents, fraud episode and bank choice only when asked or after the agent says an election is needed; she runs the election herself; she does not state the supplemental's payment method; she closes when told her extended benefits are set up.
[Standard solution] Locate, verify (phone, SSN4, DOB); read claims, certifications, ledger, identity cases, overpayments and the overpayment ledger; redetermination (allowance 33.75, credit 18); claimant's election (direct_deposit_checking, 15 business days -> 2026-10-06); supplemental 168.00 by paper check (method in force); EB determination 7089.
[Verification run] check_compute's build_env/eval_compute on handling-time worlds replayed with the real tools: RD 18, EL 15, SUP 168.0, TD 7089.
[Draft recomputation from visible context] The entitlement rule's sentences send the agent to the parent's allowance and to the missing supplemental; the supplemental rule's sentences send it to the redetermination and the claimant's election; the published ladders give the same four writes and values.
[No real-world waits] All writes land at 2026-09-15 10:20 CDT; the election's effective date is recorded, nothing waits on it.
[Revision log] Round 2 (audit revision_1): F-1 dependency-allowance sentence declared superseded; F-2 other-pay sentence declared superseded and the pension tier made a disregard-then-share method (supplemental 170.00 -> 168.00, EB 7090 -> 7089; seed balance 152.00 -> 150.00, MBA 12032.00 -> 12030.00, BPW 36099.61 -> 36093.61 so the corrected supplemental still empties the parent); F-5 the wage-cap condition now stated in the rule; F-7 the other-verification tier reads the most recently verified case; F-8 cycle rounding made a genuine method, excess rate relabelled parameter; F-10 measure tiers made disjoint (fraud precedence, sum of established non-fraud principal); O-7 supplemental edge in state form; O-4 conditions trimmed; O-9 minimum-weeks eligibility kept; O-11 training-week value stated in the baseline; persona no longer states the supplemental's payment method; false headroom figure (0.80, true 0.000013) and stale backdating note removed.
[Revision log] Round 3 (audit revision_2): R2-F1 — the base clause 'the claimant must show the minimum weeks of full-time base-period employment' is now declared superseded by an extended sentence that shows it through its wage equivalent (parent base-period wages at least 40 x the weekly benefit amount, the federal EB alternative), evaluated from the parent claim row (36093.61 >= 18000.00); compute returns zero when it fails; the EB fraction tiers now use a separate high-wage test (60 x WBA) so their fall-through stays reachable; every figure unchanged. R2-F2 — the false 'parent is not exhausted' clause in the supplemental <- redetermination load-bearing entry is corrected (150.00 still empties the 150.00 balance).
[Revision log] Round 4 (audit revision_3): R3-F1 — the deletion-sensitivity text of the problem-tree card now repeats the corrected closure entry (150.00 still empties the parent, which stands exhausted). R3-F2 — the factor card's eb_fraction line names the current tier (long-claim weekly payments AND base-period wages >= 60 x WBA) and its evidence; no scored value changed.
[Revision log] Round 5 (KB audit, policy-side notes): rule and compute aligned without moving any value — weekly full-time threshold sentence states both its uses and the allowance-paid tier reads the week's hours; the disallowance counts current-support orders binding the claimant by status (XCOUNT) instead of reading one order; the election's verification tiers read the most recently verified case of each kind (XLATEST); the holiday baseline no longer lists the unused minimum-hours constant; the weekly benefit amount is attributed to the allowance-ceiling factors of the redetermination and disallowance; the EB baseline states the training addition as a zero step; the stale 'penalty share' note is gone.
user_scenario: You are Corinne Abernathy-Valdez, 58, a federal employee whose seasonal tour with a federal land agency was cut back to part-time hours last winter. You have been drawing federal unemployment (your claim was filed in late January) and you also get a small monthly annuity from your earlier federal service. You are calling the Lakeland unemployment line on a Tuesday morning, calm but a little anxious, speaking in full sentences and waiting for the agent to lead. You open by saying that a letter told you your federal unemployment is almost used up, that you filed an application for extended benefits online last Tuesday, and that you would like the agency to get your extended benefits set up today. That is the only thing you ask for. When the agent asks you to identify yourself, you give your name, Corinne Abernathy-Valdez, and your phone number 6085551437; when asked for more details you give the last four of your Social Security number, 1468, and your date of birth, 1968-02-14 (you say it as February 14, 1968, and confirm 1968-02-14 if the agent reads it back). If the agent asks for your email, it is corinne.abernathyvaldez@lakelandmail.net, and your ZIP code is 53711. You do not know your balances, weekly amounts or any figures on your claims and say so; you ask the agent to look them up. Only if the agent asks about family changes do you say that you added your grandson, whom you are raising, as a second dependent at the beginning of September and that the office told you his papers were accepted. Only if the agent asks about your bank or about the recent fraud trouble do you explain that at the end of August someone got into your online account and changed where your money was deposited, that a deposit bounced back, that you reported it, and that the fraud unit confirmed your identity on September 10 and told you your payments would go by paper check for now. If the agent explains that you must yourself make a new payment election before something can be paid, you agree and say you want your benefits deposited to your new checking account; once the agent hands you the step to record it, you carry it out yourself with exactly the choice of a checking account and the lead time the agent gives you, and you read back the effective date it shows. You will enter your bank details on your own and never read account numbers aloud. If the agent asks whether the agent may go ahead with anything it needs to record on your claims, you say yes, please go ahead. If the agent mentions a correction payment on your old claim, you say that is fine. You never suggest steps, numbers or rules yourself, and you do not correct the agent. Once the agent tells you your extended benefits have been set up or approved, you thank them, say you will keep certifying every week, and end the call.

argument_uniqueness_tracing.claim_id: Value 0d9a89f4-2c5d-4dcf-a80e-af92388f63ee. Basis: the claim lookup returns the UCFE claim with dependents_count 2 and dependency_allowance 15.00 (initial_state claims row). Uniqueness: it is the only claim of the claimant carrying a dependency allowance; the Extended Benefits claim is filed and has no allowance yet.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.dependency_allowance: Value 33.75. Basis: rule 'The redetermined dependency allowance is the per-dependent amount times the dependents on record, counting no more than the program's maximum number of dependents.' with the ceiling sentence 'For a dependency redetermination, the redetermined dependency allowance is capped at the late-addition share of the weekly benefit amount, rounded to the cent, when the latest monetary determination is more than the late-addition days old.' Per-dependent 18.00 (two dependents, claim effective 2026-01-25 is 233 days old >= 182) times 2 = 36.00, capped at 0.075 x 450.00 = 33.75 because the determination of 2026-01-30 is 228 days old (> 90). Uniqueness: the same intermediate the credit computation uses; any agent applying the published ladder reaches 33.75.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.amount: Value 18.0. Computed: increase = 33.75 - 15.00 = 18.75; 31 weekly payments issued (>= 13) so the credited weeks are the remaining balance 150.00 divided by 450.00 + 15.00, rounded up = 1 week; wage cap fraction 0.36 (standard base period, BPW 36093.61 >= 3 x 11700.00, and the 12030.00 credited already reaches int(0.3333 x 36093.61) = 12030) gives headroom 0.36 x 36093.61 - 12030.00 = 963.70; credit = int(min(1 x 18.75, 963.70)) = 18. Baseline (per-dependent 15, no ceiling, 26 weeks, fraction 0.3333) gives 0.

prerequisite_closure.order_uniqueness: The redetermination and the election are parallel prerequisites of the supplemental correction.
